description_en: Cancels the quota configured for a fileset
description_zh: 取消文件集设置的配额
kebab_example: aliyun nas cancel-fileset-quota --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya0000 --fset-id fset-1902718ea0ae0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelFilesetQuota

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CPFS for Lingjun file system. The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.help_zh: CPFS智算版文件系统ID。必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run.

A dry run validates the parameter validity and business constraints without actually canceling the fileset quota or incurring any charges.

Valid values:

true: Sends a dry run request without canceling the quota. The system checks required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, HTTP status code 200 is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the fileset quota is directly canceled
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检。

预检操作会校验参数有效性和业务约束条件，并不会实际取消文件集配额，也不会产生费用。

取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会取消配额。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200 HttpCode。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接取消文件集配额
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
